contradict_spans: Five years earlier she underwent bilateral lung transplantation for severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (FEV1 15%)
Prophylactic antimicrobial therapy includes trimethoprim–sulfamethoxazole, itraconazole, and valganciclovir (continued for detectable CMV viremia)
CT of the abdomen and pelvis reveals a non-obstructing right nephrolithiasis and irregular, nodular thickening of the bladder wall, suspicious for neoplasm
